comment: Identify the tool honestly to the stores it scrapes. politeFetch sets this User-Agent itself on the server, but a browser refuses to let fetch() set it, so the header is applied at the network layer instead. Without this the extension would arrive looking like an ordinary Edge/Chrome visitor, which is exactly the anonymity this project has always declined to take.

requestHeaders.value: GamePriceIL/0.1 (personal wishlist price tracker for Israel)
